changes.motivation: Add a test suite to the CLI project which previously had no tests
changes.summary: Added 134 bun:test tests across 13 co-located test files covering: CLI parser (extractGlobalFlags, parseCommandArgs, parse), help text generation, builder name utilities, dashboard stat parser, memory formatter, health color logic, poll-status parser, remote command parser, uptime calculator, cost formatter, ANSI colorizer, Hcloud service (37 tests with Effect TestClock and fetch mocks), and SSH service error classification. Test script added to package.json.

changes.motivation: Plan originally specified vitest but bun 1.3.3 corrupts package.json files when installing packages via the shared global cache, making vitest unusable
changes.summary: Switched from vitest to bun:test (native, zero-dependency). Changed import from 'vitest' to 'bun:test', vi.setSystemTime() to setSystemTime() from bun:test, test script from 'vitest run' to 'bun test'.

changes.motivation: Private functions needed to be accessible for unit testing
changes.summary: Added export keyword to extractGlobalFlags and parseCommandArgs in src/cli/parser.ts, and buildSshArgs in src/services/Ssh.ts.

changes.motivation: hcloud server create was failing with 'JSON Parse error: Unexpected EOF' because --user-data-from-file - reads from stdin but ShellService.exec does not pipe stdin
changes.summary: Replaced hcloud CLI call for createServer with direct Hetzner API fetch() call against https://api.hetzner.cloud/v1/servers. Also moved FileSystem access from node:fs to @effect/platform FileSystem service, providing BunContext.layer in main.ts and tests.

changes.motivation: Hetzner API returns immediately with server in 'initializing' status, causing croc send to fail because the builder process isn't up yet
changes.summary: Added waitForRunning?: boolean option to CreateServerOptions. When true, polls GET /v1/servers/{id} every 5 seconds until status === 'running' (300s timeout). The create handler passes waitForRunning: true and prints status messages.

changes.motivation: The volumes field accepted string names like 'ccache-builder-1', which .map(Number) converted to NaN, serializing as null in JSON and causing Hetzner API to return 'failed to parse json'
changes.summary: Changed CreateServerOptions.volumes from readonly string[] to readonly number[] (volume IDs). Updated the create handler to pass volume IDs from createVolume return value or existingVolume.id.

changes.motivation: Partial server initialization leaves an orphaned Hetzner server that wastes money and can't be used
changes.summary: Wrapped all post-create logic in Effect.onError that calls hcloud.deleteServer(name) on failure, printing status messages. Original error is re-raised after cleanup.

changes.motivation: Install script generation was inlined as a large heredoc in the create handler, making it hard to read and test
changes.summary: Extracted createInstallScript() as a pure function into src/commands/builders/create/install-script.ts with typed InstallScriptSecrets and InstallScriptOptions interfaces and a writeFile helper. Added 7 tests in install-script.test.ts.

changes.motivation: Developer ergonomics: need a quick way to run the TypeScript compiler without building
Apply the strictest available ESLint ruleset to catch type safety issues and code quality problems
changes.summary: Upgraded eslint.config.ts from tseslint.configs.recommended to strictTypeChecked + stylisticTypeChecked. Added pragmatic overrides: allowNumber/allowBoolean in restrict-template-expressions, disabled no-non-null-assertion (redundant with noUncheckedIndexedAccess), disabled no-unnecessary-type-parameters (conflicts with Effect patterns), configured _ prefix for unused vars, relaxed unsafe rules in test files. Added 'lint': 'eslint src/' script and jiti devDependency.

changes.motivation: Applying strictTypeChecked revealed 435 pre-existing violations across the codebase
changes.summary: Fixed all 435 ESLint errors: replaced require() with ESM imports (readline, node:fs), || to ?? for nullish coalescing, typed JSON.parse() results, fixed restrict-template-expressions with String() or ?? fallbacks, removed/prefixed unused vars, fixed useless escapes in shell script template literals, replaced confusing x! === y with (x ?? '') === y, fixed no-base-to-string, added void for no-misused-promises, replaced deprecated substr() with substring(), added eslint-disable for runtime-mutated loop conditions.

changes.motivation: Bun's shared global cache was corrupted, causing 158+ packages to have empty package.json and source files, breaking ESLint and other tooling
changes.summary: Created bunfig.toml setting [install] cache = '.bun/cache' to use a project-local cache directory. Added .bun/ to .gitignore. Clean reinstall with local cache produced zero empty files.

changes.motivation: tsconfig.json was not aligned with Bun's recommended TypeScript configuration
changes.summary: Updated tsconfig.json: target/module to ESNext/Preserve, types to ['bun'], added verbatimModuleSyntax, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, noImplicitOverride, moduleDetection:force. Fixed all resulting noUncheckedIndexedAccess errors with ! assertions in 7 source files.

changes.motivation: The CLI was built as an interpreted writeShellApplication running bun run src/main.ts, carrying node_modules in the Nix store and requiring bun at runtime
changes.summary: Integrated bun2nix: generated bun.nix from bun.lock, rewrote default.nix to use bun2nix-cli.mkDerivation producing a 44MB standalone compiled binary. Added a writeShellApplication wrapper to inject runtime deps (curl, openssl, croc, netcat, tailscale, openssh) into PATH. Source filter excludes .git, .claude, .bun, node_modules, dist, croc-* files. Added CLI to bunProjects in lib/devshell/default.nix for pre-commit hooks.

changes.motivation: bun2nix's bun install phase fails in the Nix sandbox because bun tries to fetch npm registry manifests even with a fully-populated cache (missing .npm manifest files that bun2nix doesn't generate)
changes.summary: Worked around bun2nix issue #77 by overriding bunNodeModulesInstallPhase via postBunSetInstallCacheDirPhase: copies cache to writable temp dir, symlinks all 306 packages into node_modules directly, sets NODE_PATH for cross-package resolution, skips lifecycle scripts via dontRunLifecycleScripts.

changes.motivation: croc creates temp files named croc-stdin-* in the working directory, and the retry loop was using try/catch which does not catch Effect failures in generators
changes.summary: Added cwd option to ShellService.exec so croc runs with cwd: '/tmp'. Fixed the croc retry loop and Tailscale polling loop to use Effect.either instead of try/catch. Now logs error messages on each retry attempt showing the failure reason.

changes.motivation: Test fixture contained PEM-formatted fake SSH key strings that triggered gitleaks secret scanning hook
changes.summary: Replaced fake PEM key strings in install-script.test.ts with plain placeholder strings. Tests continue to pass as they assert on file paths and structure, not key content.

problems: The plan specified vitest but vitest was unusable due to bun 1.3.3's shared global cache being corrupted (empty package.json and source files for ~170 packages). The root cause was the shared cache, not bun itself — discovered only after extensive debugging. A bunfig.toml with a local cache dir resolved it. This should have been documented as a known issue.

Effect.gen generators silently swallow try/catch — JavaScript try/catch does not catch Effect failures. This caused the croc retry loop to fail on the first attempt and not retry, and also broke Tailscale status polling. The fix is to use Effect.either. This is a subtle Effect footgun with no compiler warning.

hcloud server create --user-data-from-file - reads from stdin, but @effect/platform's Command.string() does not pipe stdin. The error manifested as 'JSON Parse error: Unexpected EOF' which is the hcloud CLI's error message, not a JSON error in our code — the error message was misleading and the root cause was non-obvious.

bun2nix's fetchBunDeps generates a cache directory but does not generate .npm manifest cache files that bun requires to resolve packages without hitting the network. This caused bun install to fail in the Nix sandbox. Workaround required overriding the install phase entirely and manually symlinking node_modules from the cache. This is bun2nix issue #77 and should be documented as a known workaround pattern.

The croc send command creates croc-stdin-* temp files in the current working directory, not /tmp. A leftover croc-stdin-* file owned by nobody:nogroup in the CLI source directory caused the Nix build sandbox to fail with a permission error when copying the source. The ShellService needed a cwd option to direct these files to /tmp. The source filter also needed a croc-* exclusion pattern.

volumes in CreateServerOptions was typed as readonly string[] (names) but the Hetzner API requires integer volume IDs. The .map(Number) on names like 'ccache-builder-1' produced NaN, which JSON.stringify serializes as null, causing the API to return 'failed to parse json'. Better typing (readonly number[]) would have caught this at compile time.

bun2nix mkDerivation does not document that dontRunLifecycleScripts must be set when overriding the install phase, and that NODE_PATH must be set for cross-package imports when manually constructing node_modules via symlinks. This required significant trial and error to discover.
